QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Letters from an Assassin
QuestInfo.0: The envelope Il Capo was carrying was empty. See if Leon knows anything.
QuestInfo.1: The envelope Il Capo was carrying was empty, but it looked like somebody had torn it open in a hurry. One of the assassins must have stolen the contents when they saw you. Go defeat the assassins, and find that letter!
QuestInfo.2: The envelope Il Capo was carrying was empty, but it looked like somebody had torn it open in a hurry. One of the assassins must have stolen the contents when they saw you. You pursued the assassins and found the secret documents. Leon is taking a look.

0.msg: Wonder why he had an empty envelope with him...

1.msg: I think he opened it in a hurry. The Assassins looked pretty shady when we got here, like they were trying to hide something... Maybe he still has whatever was in the envelope...

2.msg: You must be right! We should look for the document after hunting down the Guild Assassins.

yes.0: Let's each look for it! Talk to me when you find the document!

no.0: We have to look for whatever was in the envelope...

yes.0: I knew it! One of the Guild Assassins had it. Let's take a look.
yes.1:
I'll read this document, give me a minute.
Talk to me in a little bit, I have to take my time to read this.

item.0: Did you get the document that was inside the envelope?
